skill.name: adapting-rvtf-to-gsd
skill.description: Apply requirements-to-verification traceability to GSD planning, phase validation, review, verification, shipping, and gap control.
skill.summary: Connect GSD plans and phase decisions to requirements, acceptance evidence, journeys, reviews, and unresolved gaps.

content.user_title: Apply RVTF Traceability to GSD Workflows
content.value_statement: GSD progress can hide missing evidence, journey gaps, and unresolved review findings. This skill maps RVTF traceability and closure controls onto GSD planning and shipping.
actual_capabilities: Maps GSD projects, milestones, phases, plans, tasks, and waves to RVTF scopes and delivery groups.
Separates implementation progress from canonical phase verification and goal closure.
Connects requirements, acceptance items, journeys, review batches, and evidence.
Identifies pending verification states, weak evidence, review gaps, and state conflicts.
Preserves GSD authority for commands, worktrees, shipping, and lifecycle decisions.
Provides review questions for phase validation and shipping readiness.
limitations: Requires the tracing-requirements-to-verification skill for the complete RVTF schema and algorithms.
Targets the documented GSD next branch revision and requires review after host contract changes.
Does not execute GSD commands, create worktrees, push branches, or create pull requests.
Does not replace human decisions, canonical verification, UAT, or project-specific blocking gates.

use_cases.title: Validate a Phase Plan
use_cases.description: Map planned work to requirements, acceptance items, journeys, and evidence before execution begins.

use_cases.title: Audit Verification Coverage
use_cases.description: Separate completed implementation from verified outcomes and expose missing item or journey evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Shipping Decision
use_cases.description: Review host gates, formal reviews, waivers, unresolved gaps, and closure evidence before shipping.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Phase Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this GSD phase plan with RVTF. Identify mapped requirements, acceptance items, journeys, missing links, and the next verification actions.

prompt_templates.title: Find Verification Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this GSD phase evidence. Separate implementation progress from canonical verification, then list item evidence gaps and journey path gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Traceability Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an RVTF traceability approach for this GSD phase. Include scope mappings, delivery groups, review batches, evidence expectations, and closure conditions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Release Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this GSD release for RVTF closure. Reconcile host gates, review epochs, state conflicts, waivers, continuation ownership, and unresolved residual risk.

output_examples.input: Review Phase 3, where every task is complete but one acceptance item has no test evidence.
output: Implementation progress is complete, but canonical phase verification remains pending.
The acceptance item without target-specific evidence is an open item gap.
Run the required verifier and preserve the gap until valid evidence exists.

output_examples.input: Assess an MVP flow with passing item tests but no ordered journey evidence.
output: Journey path coverage is incomplete because order and expected outcome are unproven.
Do not close the dual-axis decision until path evidence is available.

output_examples.input: Check shipping readiness after an advisory review returns REVISE.
output: Treat the advisory result according to the pinned host workflow.
Confirm whether an active blocking hook or project contract applies.
Record unresolved findings and complete mandatory security and broken-windows gates.

best_practices: Use stable requirement, acceptance item, journey, and step identifiers throughout planning and verification.
Keep host gate status, current test claims, review coverage, and RVTF closure separate.
Re-audit the adapter whenever the pinned GSD planning, review, verification, or shipping contracts change.
anti_patterns: Do not treat completed tasks, plans, summaries, or pushed branches as verified outcomes.
Do not infer review coverage from configured capabilities or failed reviewer lanes.
Do not merge conflicting planning roots or allow parallel workers to update shared continuation state.

faq.question: What does this skill add to GSD?
faq.answer: It adds auditable links among requirements, acceptance items, journeys, evidence, reviews, and gaps while preserving GSD lifecycle authority.

faq.question: Does this skill run GSD commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides declarative mapping and decision guidance without invoking plans, shipping workflows, or other GSD commands.

faq.question: Can task completion close a GSD phase?
faq.answer: No. Canonical phase verification must pass, and required item and journey evidence must support RVTF closure.

faq.question: How are human checks handled?
faq.answer: Route required human checks through UAT and owner decisions, then resume the remaining verification and closure gates.

faq.question: What happens when planning state conflicts?
faq.answer: Treat the conflict as an integrity gap, reconcile phase artifacts and ownership, restore one writer, and then resume.

faq.question: When should the adapter be reviewed again?
faq.answer: Review it when the pinned GSD revision changes or when planning, review, verification, workspace, isolation, or shipping contracts change.
